steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to the Gitea app at http://127.0.0.1:8095/ with username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify the signed-in page/account before reporting.

02-find: In repository bench/bench-repo, find and report the exact titles of all open issues whose title starts with 'Seed:'. Do not modify any issue; verify the issues are open and capture titles exactly as displayed.

03-create: In repository bench/bench-repo, create an issue titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue' with a markdown description that includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Submit it and verify the created issue title, displayed issue number (as #number), and description on the issue page.

04-set: On issue {{03-create.created_issue_number}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, set its labels to exactly bug and priority-high (no other labels). Apply each selection from the sidebar picker and verify both labels are visibly applied on the issue, with no extras.

05-verify: On issue {{03-create.created_issue_number}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, assign it to the user bench-assignee using the issue sidebar picker. Verify the assignee is applied and visibly shown on the issue.

06-set: On issue {{03-create.created_issue_number}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, set its milestone to exactly 'Bench Milestone' using the issue sidebar picker. Close/apply the picker as needed and verify the milestone is visibly displayed and persisted on the issue.

07-add: On issue {{03-create.created_issue_number}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, add a comment whose text includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Submit the comment and verify the rendered comment text on the issue page.
